目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one life form that appears to thrive in this environment - the space amoeba. Giving up their otherwise fairly solitary lifestyle, they have congregated in great numbers, flitting in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned their flagella towards the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one life form that appears to thrive in this environment - the space amoeba. Giving up their otherwise fairly solitary lifestyle, they have congregated in great numbers, flitting in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Fortunately, however, they appear content to share it with us, and have made no hostile moves toward the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但尽管如此，这里似乎居住着大量前所未知的大型太空有机体。它们在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，似乎在进行精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚此星系对这些生物有什么吸引力。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向我们，公然以一种威胁的姿态接近[Root.GetName]。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, despite all this, it seems to be inhabited in large numbers by a previously unknown large spaceborne organism, groups of which flit in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what attraction this system could possibly hold for these creatures. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned towards us, approaching the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

texts.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的领地，出于天性，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们的哨站。
texts.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts.

texts.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。现在可以观测到，它们数量惊人，正浩浩荡荡地穿越[FromFrom.GetName]星系。幸运的是，我们已经揭开了与这些巨型生物和平共处的奥秘，因此我们不必过度担忧它们的活动。
texts.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, and can now be seen crossing the [FromFrom.GetName] system in impressive numbers. Fortunately, we have uncovered the secret to peaceful coexistence with these majestic beings, so we need not be overly concerned at their movements..

texts.zh: 一大群太空有机体已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们的领地，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的哨站。
texts.en: A large group of spaceborne organisms has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, bringing them into our own territory. They seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts in the [FromFrom.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
星海共同体已通过太空变形虫保护法案议案，要求帝国与太空变形虫和平共处。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
texts.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the Space Amoeba Protection Act resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with Space Amoebas.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

summary.text:
# 繁育之所 / Breeding Grounds

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_features_events.txt:4163-4350`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:927`; `common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:13021`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

500：首次进入太空变形虫的巢穴系统（标记 amoeba_home_system，有 amoeba_garrison 舰队）；502：变形虫群离开巢穴到达本国领土时（hidden 501 → 502）；505：银河共同体通过“太空变形虫保护法案”时。

500: first entering the Space Amoeba home system (flag amoeba_home_system with an amoeba_garrison fleet); 502: when an amoeba wave leaves home and reaches the empire's space (hidden 501 -> 502); 505: when the Galactic Community passes the Space Amoeba Protection Act.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

500 / 502 都是警告（选项“战斗岗位！”，若已有 pacified_amoebas 修正则是“有趣”）；505 在决议通过后让玩家选择遵守（获得永久的 pacified_amoebas 修正，并使所有变形虫国家中立）或拒绝（视为害虫）。

500 and 502 are warnings (option "Battlestations!", or "Interesting" with the pacified_amoebas modifier); 505 after the resolution lets the player comply (permanent pacified_amoebas modifier, all amoeba countries become neutral) or refuse (treat them as pests).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

遵守 / 拒绝法案。

Comply / refuse the act.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文依是否与变形虫国家有通讯、是否已安抚而异。

The text differs by contact with the amoeba countries and by pacification.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

原先的 event-galactic-features-501 与 -505 并入本故事。

The former event-galactic-features-501 and -505 are merged here.
